title: Successor relay works inside the Herdr desktop app (hc) as well as the herdr multiplexer
body:
Why: operator plans to move from the herdr 0.9.5 multiplexer to the Herdr desktop app (herdrdev/herdr-app over herdr-core, CLI `hc` + `herdr-app do`). Research 2026-11-14: NOT READY: different CLI, OpenRPC protocol (herdr-core/schema/hc.openrpc.json), model spaces/tabs/panes/terminals (t7), env HC_TERMINAL_ID instead of HERDR_PANE_ID. KRN calls: herdr status, tab create/list/close, pane run/get/list/process-info/close, agent get/wait, tab rename (src/successor/{launch,retire,probe,compose,herdr}.ts), allowlist src/context/gauge.ts:118, skills krn-handoff and context-relay.
Outcome: src/successor talks to a backend interface with a herdr (TUI) and an hc (desktop) implementation, chosen by HC_TERMINAL_ID vs HERDR_PANE_ID; launch, retire and probe work on both; skills name both.
Proof: tests against verbatim captured `hc` replies (KRN-12) for every call; a live successor-launch + --retire round trip inside the desktop app.
Blocked on: herdr-app/hc installed on this host (operator install).
Fable 1114e slice 2: after t-8d0sn15, add host-hc.ts adapter + test/fixtures/hc captures; same contract suite.

2026-11-15: herdr-app 0.1.14 is packaged in the official omarchy repo (pacman -S herdr-app, URL github.com/herdrdev/herdr-app); install needs sudo with a password, so the lead cannot install it unattended. Operator: run 'sudo pacman -S herdr-app' if you use the desktop app; the task resumes then.
